title: LEMOE: LLM-Enhanced Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization for Microarchitecture Exploration
problem: Design space exploration for processor microarchitecture is challenging due to vast design space and multiple competing metrics; traditional algorithm-driven approaches cannot effectively incorporate expert domain knowledge.
motivation: Microarchitecture design is expensive and time-consuming; better DSE methods incorporating expert knowledge can accelerate optimization and improve design quality.
method: Uses LLM to enhance implicit Bayesian model for multi-objective optimization; features program-aware warm-up phase utilizing LLM and LLVM to produce initial design set with rich prior knowledge; leverages LLM contextual learning to improve surrogate modeling under sparse data.
key_novelty: LLM-enhanced Bayesian optimization framework that uses LLM contextual learning to improve surrogate models and sampling efficiency for microarchitecture DSE.
contributions: LLM-enhanced implicit Bayesian model for microarchitecture multi-objective optimization
Program-aware warm-up phase leveraging LLM and LLVM for initial design set generation
Improved surrogate modeling under sparse data via LLM contextual learning
22.8% energy efficiency improvement with same iteration count; 2.9× runtime speedup
limitations: Limited to CPU microarchitecture; applicability to heterogeneous or accelerator DSE not discussed.
primary_theme: LLM-enhanced Bayesian optimization for microarchitecture design space exploration
